name: verb-jump
prompt: The robot in a vertical jump take-off pose. Both knees bent, arms swinging upward, body just beginning to leave the ground. Captured at the instant of push-off.

name: verb-leap
prompt: The robot mid-leap forward at the apex, body fully extended horizontally, one leg trailing back, both arms outstretched ahead reaching for landing. Captured at the highest point of the arc.

name: verb-hop
prompt: The robot mid-hop on one foot, the opposite knee tucked up high, both arms used for balance. Captured at the airborne moment of a small hop.

name: verb-vault
prompt: The robot mid-vault crossing an unseen obstacle, one hand planted as if pushing off a low wall, legs tucked and swinging across to the side. Captured at the peak of the lateral swing.

name: verb-frontflip
prompt: The robot mid-frontflip rotation, body inverted forward at the apex with knees tucked tight to the chest, arms tucked in. Captured at the upside-down moment of the rotation.

name: verb-cartwheel
prompt: The robot mid-cartwheel rotation, body horizontal with one hand planted on the ground and the other reaching up, both legs extended in opposite directions. Captured halfway through the sideways rotation.

name: verb-roll
prompt: The robot mid forward-roll, body curled tightly with the shoulder rolling toward the ground, hips coming over. Captured during the tumbling phase.

name: verb-dive
prompt: The robot mid forward-dive, body fully extended horizontally with arms thrust ahead and legs straight behind, head leading. Captured airborne in a stretched-out dive.

name: verb-slide
prompt: The robot in a low feet-first slide, one leg extended forward and bent, the other leg tucked, both hands trailing behind for balance, torso leaning back. Captured mid-slide.

name: verb-land
prompt: The robot in a heroic three-point landing pose: one knee on the ground, other foot planted, one fist planted on the floor, the other arm trailing back, head down. Captured at the moment of impact absorption.

name: verb-swing
prompt: The robot mid-swing hanging from an overhead grip with both hands, body swinging in pendulum motion with legs extended forward. Captured at the forward apex of the swing.

name: verb-crouch-walk
prompt: The robot in a low stealthy crouching forward walk, knees deeply bent, weight low, mid-stride with one foot forward and weight on the back leg. Captured during forward movement in low posture.

name: verb-crawl
prompt: The robot crawling forward on hands and knees, opposite hand-and-knee advanced together. Captured mid-stride at low ground level.

name: verb-climb
prompt: The robot scaling an unseen vertical surface, one hand reaching up high, the other gripping at chest level, one foot pushing up, body close to the wall. Captured mid-climb.

name: verb-swim
prompt: The robot in a horizontal swimming pose as if performing a freestyle stroke, one arm extended forward in entry, the other arm pulling back at hip, body level. Captured mid-stroke.

name: verb-skate
prompt: The robot in a forward skating glide stance, knees bent low, body leaning forward, one leg extended back in push-off, arms swinging in counter-balance. Captured mid-glide.

name: verb-ride
prompt: The robot in a mounted riding posture, sitting astride an invisible mount with knees bent at the sides, hands gripping invisible reins held in front, back straight. Captured in a steady riding pose.

name: verb-tiptoe
prompt: The robot tiptoeing forward stealthily on the balls of the feet, knees slightly bent, arms held up at the sides for balance, body very upright and light. Captured mid-step on tiptoes.

name: verb-attack
prompt: The robot in a generic forward-strike attack pose, right arm wound back and the elbow cocked ready to throw a strike, weight loaded on the front foot, body coiled with energy. Captured at the wind-up.

name: verb-kick
prompt: The robot mid-roundhouse kick, the right leg extended out to the side at hip height with the foot pointed, hips fully rotated, both arms in counter-balance. Captured at full kick extension.

name: verb-slash
prompt: The robot mid-slash with an invisible blade in the right hand, arm sweeping across the body in a horizontal arc, hips rotated for power. Captured at the peak of the sweep.

name: verb-stab
prompt: The robot mid-stab thrust, right arm fully extended forward in a pointed stab motion with an invisible dagger, left arm pulled back, hips driving forward. Captured at the moment of thrust extension.

name: verb-thrust
prompt: The robot in a powerful forward thrust pose, both arms extended forward at shoulder height pushing a heavy invisible weight, body leaned into the push, one foot far forward. Captured at the moment of max forward push.

name: verb-parry
prompt: The robot in a parry stance, the right forearm raised across the body to deflect an incoming strike, weight shifted slightly to the back foot, head turned toward the threat. Captured at the moment of contact.

name: verb-block
prompt: The robot in a hard block stance, both forearms crossed in front of the face in a defensive X, knees slightly bent, weight braced. Captured at the moment of impact absorption.

name: verb-dodge
prompt: The robot in a quick sideways dodge step, body twisted to one side, lead foot landing wide, the trailing foot lifting off, arms pulled in tight. Captured at the moment of evasion.

name: verb-riposte
prompt: The robot in a counter-strike riposte pose, having just deflected, now thrusting forward with a quick straight extension of the right arm, off-hand still trailing in guard. Captured at the moment of counter-extension.

name: verb-shoot
prompt: The robot in a two-handed firing stance with an invisible pistol, both hands together at face-height aiming forward, one eye sighting down the imaginary barrel, knees slightly bent. Captured at the moment of the shot.

name: verb-reload
prompt: The robot reloading an invisible firearm, the right hand inserting an invisible magazine into the left-hand grip held at chest level, head looking down at the action. Captured mid-reload.

name: verb-aim
prompt: The robot in a careful aiming stance with an invisible long rifle, the left hand supporting the barrel forward, the right hand at the trigger by the cheek, knees bent for stability. Captured in held aim.

name: verb-draw
prompt: The robot drawing an invisible sword from a hip sheath, right hand gripping an invisible hilt and pulling diagonally across the body, the off-hand pushing the invisible scabbard down. Captured mid-draw.

name: verb-sheathe
prompt: The robot sheathing an invisible blade back into a left-hip scabbard, the right hand lowering the invisible blade tip into an invisible sheath held by the left hand. Captured mid-sheathe.

name: verb-charge
prompt: The robot in a powerful charging forward rush, body fully leaned into the run, one arm forward extended for a shoulder-tackle, the other arm trailing back, knees driving high. Captured mid-charge.

name: verb-retreat
prompt: The robot in a controlled backward retreat step, body still facing forward but feet moving backward, arms in a guarded ready position, eyes on the threat ahead. Captured mid-back-step.

name: verb-taunt
prompt: The robot in a taunting beckoning pose, one hand extended forward with fingers curled in a come-here gesture, the other hand on the hip, chest forward, body language openly provocative. Captured mid-beckon.

name: verb-clap
prompt: The robot clapping hands at chest height, both palms about to meet flat together in front of the chest, elbows out. Captured at the moment of impact.

name: verb-point
prompt: The robot pointing forward with the right index finger fully extended at shoulder height, the rest of the fingers curled, the off-hand by the side, head following the gesture. Captured at full point extension.

name: verb-beckon
prompt: The robot beckoning someone closer with the right hand, palm up and fingers curling inward repeatedly toward the chest, the left hand on the hip, friendly but commanding posture. Captured mid-curl.

name: verb-salute
prompt: The robot in a formal military salute, the right hand flat against the brow with the fingers extended, the left arm straight at the side, posture rigidly upright and disciplined. Captured at the apex of the salute.

name: verb-bow
prompt: The robot in a respectful bow, the torso bent forward at the hips about 45 degrees, both arms straight at the sides, head lowered. Captured at the deepest point of the bow.

name: verb-shrug
prompt: The robot in an exaggerated shrug, both shoulders raised high near the ears, both hands turned palms-up at hip height, head slightly tilted. Captured at the peak of the shrug.

name: verb-nod
prompt: The robot mid-nod, head tilted slightly forward and down in a clear affirmative gesture, body otherwise relaxed in neutral stance. Captured at the downward point of the nod.

name: verb-shake-head
prompt: The robot mid head-shake in refusal, head turned sharply to one side mid-rotation in a clear 'no' gesture, body otherwise still and relaxed. Captured mid-rotation.

name: verb-thumbs-up
prompt: The robot giving a confident thumbs-up, the right hand at chest height with the thumb extended skyward and the rest of the fingers curled, the off-hand relaxed at the side. Captured in held gesture.

name: verb-facepalm
prompt: The robot in a facepalm reaction, the right palm pressed flat against the front of the helmet visor, head tilted slightly forward, the off-hand on the hip in exasperation. Captured in held gesture.

name: verb-handshake
prompt: The robot with the right hand extended forward at chest level offering an open handshake, palm vertical with the thumb up, the off-hand by the side, body leaning slightly forward in greeting. Captured at the moment of offer.

name: verb-high-five
prompt: The robot raising the right hand high for a high-five, palm forward at face-height with fingers spread, the off-hand at the side, body slightly turned to one side for the meeting hand. Captured at the moment just before contact.

name: verb-fist-bump
prompt: The robot offering a fist-bump, the right hand at chest height fist clenched and knuckles forward, the off-hand by the side, body angled invitingly. Captured at the moment of offer.

name: verb-laugh
prompt: The robot in a laughing pose, head tilted back, both shoulders shaking with mirth, one hand on the belly, the other thrown out, body language clearly amused. Captured mid-laugh.

name: verb-cry
prompt: The robot in a sobbing pose, shoulders curled forward and shaking, both hands covering the visor area of the helmet, head bowed deeply, body language clearly distressed. Captured mid-sob.

name: verb-yawn
prompt: The robot in a wide yawning stretch, the helmet visor opened slightly as if mouth wide, both arms reaching overhead in an exhausted stretch. Captured at the peak of the yawn-stretch.

name: verb-sigh
prompt: The robot in an exaggerated sigh pose, shoulders dropping noticeably downward, head tilted slightly back, both arms hanging loose, body language deflated. Captured at the end of the exhale.

name: verb-flinch
prompt: The robot in a flinch recoil, body twisted sharply away from an unseen threat to one side, one shoulder raised defensively, head turned away. Captured at the moment of involuntary recoil.

name: verb-shiver
prompt: The robot in a cold-shiver pose, both arms wrapped tightly around the chest, shoulders raised and tense, body visibly trembling and hunched. Captured at peak shiver.

name: verb-cheer
prompt: The robot in a celebratory cheer, both arms thrown straight up overhead in triumph, feet mid-jump just off the ground, head tilted back. Captured at the apex of the celebration jump.

name: verb-idle
prompt: The robot in a relaxed standing idle pose, weight on one leg in slight contrapposto, arms hanging easy at the sides, head level, subtle breathing posture. Captured in a calm neutral stance.

name: verb-idle-combat
prompt: The robot in a wary combat-ready idle stance, weight evenly distributed and slightly forward, hands raised in a guarded position near the chest, knees slightly bent, ready to react. Captured in held combat stance.

name: verb-sit
prompt: The robot sitting upright on an invisible chair, knees bent at 90 degrees with feet flat on the floor, hands resting on the thighs, back straight, head level. Captured in a relaxed seated pose.

name: verb-sit-floor
prompt: The robot sitting on the ground cross-legged, both legs folded in front, hands resting on the knees, back upright, head level. Captured in a calm seated-floor pose.

name: verb-lean
prompt: The robot leaning against an invisible wall, one shoulder pressed back as if against a vertical surface, hips angled out, one ankle crossed over the other, arms folded across the chest. Captured in a relaxed lean.

name: verb-kneel
prompt: The robot in a single-knee kneel, the right knee on the floor, the left foot flat in front, the right hand resting on the raised left knee, head bowed slightly. Captured in held respectful kneel.

name: verb-lie-down
prompt: The robot lying down supine on the floor, fully extended on the back with arms relaxed at the sides, legs straight, helmet pointing up at the ceiling. Captured at rest from a slightly elevated angle.

name: verb-sleep
prompt: The robot in a sleeping pose lying on the side, knees gently curled toward the chest, one arm tucked under the helmet as a pillow, body relaxed. Captured from a slightly elevated angle.

name: verb-stretch
prompt: The robot in a full body overhead stretch, both arms straight up reaching for the sky with fingers interlaced, body slightly arched, weight balanced. Captured at peak stretch.

name: verb-pick-up
prompt: The robot mid pick-up motion, body bent at the knees and waist reaching down toward the floor, both hands cupped around an invisible object near the ground. Captured at the moment of grasp.

name: verb-throw
prompt: The robot in a powerful overhand throw release, right arm whipped forward and high with the wrist snapped having released an invisible projectile, hips rotated through, weight transferred to front foot. Captured just after release.

name: verb-catch
prompt: The robot catching an unseen incoming object, both hands cupped together at chest height in a receiving position, knees slightly bent to absorb the catch. Captured at the moment of catch.

name: verb-push
prompt: The robot pushing an invisible heavy object forward, both arms extended forward at chest height with palms flat against an invisible surface, body leaned forward with weight committed, legs in a wide stance. Captured at the moment of straining push.

name: verb-pull
prompt: The robot pulling an invisible heavy object backward, both arms bent at the elbows pulling toward the chest as if hauling a thick invisible rope, body leaning back with weight on the back foot. Captured at the moment of straining pull.

name: verb-carry
prompt: The robot carrying an invisible heavy object in both arms in front of the chest, the arms slightly bent supporting the unseen weight, mid-stride walking forward, back held straight under the load. Captured mid-stride.

name: verb-open-door
prompt: The robot in a doorway-opening pose, the right arm extended forward at chest height with the hand gripping an invisible doorknob and turning, weight shifted forward as if to step through. Captured at the moment of pushing the door open.

name: verb-dig
prompt: The robot in a digging pose with an invisible shovel, both hands gripping an unseen handle, the blade end pressed downward into the ground with one foot stepping on it, body bent forward for leverage. Captured at the moment of pressing the shovel in.

name: verb-chop
prompt: The robot mid overhead chop with an invisible axe, both hands raised high overhead gripping an unseen handle just at the peak of the upward swing, body slightly arched back. Captured at the apex of the wind-up before the down-chop.

name: verb-hammer
prompt: The robot mid hammer-swing, the right arm raised high overhead gripping an invisible hammer at the peak of the wind-up, the off-hand steadying an invisible nail at waist level. Captured at the top of the swing.

name: verb-craft
prompt: The robot in a bench-work crafting pose, slightly bent forward over an invisible workbench, both hands working at chest height as if shaping or assembling something, head down focused on the work. Captured mid-task.

name: verb-cook
prompt: The robot in a cooking pose, one hand stirring an invisible pot at chest height in front, the other hand holding an invisible utensil ready to taste or add ingredients, body slightly leaned over the imaginary stove. Captured mid-stir.

name: verb-drink
prompt: The robot drinking from an invisible cup, the right hand raised holding an unseen vessel tilted to the helmet visor, head tilted slightly back, the off-hand by the side. Captured mid-drink.

name: verb-eat
prompt: The robot eating, the right hand raised to the helmet visor holding an invisible piece of food, head tilted slightly down toward the hand, the off-hand resting near the chest. Captured at the moment of bringing food to mouth.

name: verb-sneak
prompt: The robot in a deep sneaking forward creep, knees deeply bent low, weight forward, mid-stride with one foot lightly touching down and the other lifted ready to advance, both arms held wide for stealthy balance. Captured mid-sneak step.

name: verb-hide
prompt: The robot pressed flat against an invisible wall in a hiding pose, back to the wall, body sideways profile, head turned to peek toward the side, one hand near the chest in a ready position. Captured in held cover stance.

name: verb-peek
prompt: The robot leaning out from invisible cover, body sideways with the lead shoulder forward, head and one eye visor peeking out around an imaginary corner, body weight on the back foot. Captured mid-peek.

name: verb-takedown
prompt: The robot mid silent takedown from behind an unseen target, one arm wrapped around the head height of an invisible neck, the other hand at chest level pulling the invisible body backward, low stable stance. Captured mid-takedown.

name: verb-pickpocket
prompt: The robot mid pickpocket maneuver, one hand sneaking sideways at hip height as if lifting something from an unseen pocket, body angled away to hide the action, the off-hand swung casually for distraction. Captured mid-lift.

name: verb-lockpick
prompt: The robot in a crouched lockpick pose, knee on the ground, both hands working at a low invisible door-lock at waist height, head down focused on the work, body twisted to one side for leverage. Captured mid-pick.

name: verb-fly
prompt: The robot in a flying superhero pose, body fully horizontal and rigid with one arm punched forward and the other trailing back, legs straight and pointed back together, helmet leading. Captured mid-flight.

name: verb-glide
prompt: The robot in a gliding pose, body horizontal but relaxed with both arms stretched out wide to the sides as wings, legs trailing back together, head forward. Captured mid-glide unpowered.

name: verb-hover
prompt: The robot in a stationary hover, body upright and vertical but feet floating just off the ground, arms slightly out to the sides with palms down, knees slightly bent in suspension. Captured held in hover.

name: verb-perch
prompt: The robot in a perched landing pose on an invisible high spot, crouched low on the balls of the feet, both hands lightly resting on the imaginary surface for balance, body compact and ready. Captured at perch landing.

name: verb-slither
prompt: The robot lying belly-down on the floor in a slithering pose, body in a subtle serpentine curve, arms slightly bent flat to the ground for forward propulsion, head raised slightly alert. Captured mid-slither from a low angle.

name: verb-gallop
prompt: The robot on all four limbs in a galloping pose, mid-stride with both front and rear limbs in their respective phases of a four-leg gallop gait, body horizontal and stretched out. Captured at the airborne phase of the gait.

name: verb-trot
prompt: The robot on all four limbs in a steady moderate trotting gait, diagonal pairs of limbs in opposite phases, body level, head up. Captured mid-trot.

name: verb-pounce
prompt: The robot mid-pounce leap, body fully airborne and stretched horizontally forward toward an unseen target, front limbs reaching ahead with hands open ready to grab, back legs trailing. Captured at the airborne apex.

name: verb-roar
prompt: The robot in a roaring display, head tilted back, chest forward and out, both arms flung wide with hands open in a powerful intimidation pose, body fully expanded. Captured at peak of roar.

name: verb-bite
prompt: The robot in a forward biting strike, head and helmet thrust forward sharply with the visor area angled down ready to clamp, body leaned in low. Captured at the moment of strike.

name: verb-flap
prompt: The robot in a standing wing-flap motion, both arms held wide as wings flapping vigorously, slight knee bend, body upright with the helmet looking ahead. Captured at the upstroke of the flap.
